research_question: Does the frozen WGC objective produce a consistent cross-script verification gain across training seeds?
epoch_choice: Fixed at epoch 9 from the original seed-42 fit-selection experiment; no per-seed checkpoint selection.
primary_endpoint: WGC minus matched-control cross-script macro ROC-AUC
success_interpretation: Direction and effect size will be reported across seeds; no new post-hoc minimum gain threshold will be invented.
